title: 2019 ESC/EAS Guidelines for the Management of Dyslipidaemias

definitions.Very High CV Risk: Established CVD, diabetes with target organ damage, eGFR <30, familial hypercholesterolemia with ASCVD, SCORE2 ≥10%
definitions.High CV Risk: Single RF markedly elevated (e.g. LDL-C >4.9 mmol/L), SCORE2 ≥5–<10%
definitions.Lp(a): Lipoprotein(a) — genetically determined; independent CV risk factor

recommendations.text: In very-high-risk patients, an LDL-C target of <55 mg/dL (1.4 mmol/L) AND ≥50% LDL-C reduction is recommended.
In high-risk patients, an LDL-C target of <70 mg/dL (1.8 mmol/L) AND ≥50% LDL-C reduction is recommended.
For very-high-risk patients experiencing a second vascular event within 2 years on maximally tolerated statin, an LDL-C target <40 mg/dL (1.0 mmol/L) may be considered.
High-intensity statins are recommended in all very-high and high-risk patients.
Ezetimibe is recommended in combination with statins when LDL-C target is not achieved.
PCSK9 inhibitors are recommended in very-high-risk patients not achieving LDL-C target on max statin + ezetimibe.
For patients with statin intolerance, bempedoic acid or PCSK9 inhibitors are recommended alternatives.
Measurement of Lp(a) at least once in each patient's lifetime is recommended to identify those at very high Lp(a) risk (>180 mg/dL).
Cascade screening for FH in first-degree relatives of FH patients is recommended.
Omega-3 fatty acids (4 g/day icosapent ethyl) should be considered for patients with hypertriglyceridaemia at high/very high risk.
Inclisiran is recommended to lower LDL-C in patients with ASCVD or FH at very high risk not achieving LDL-C goals.

score2_risk_tool.description: SCORE2 estimates 10-year risk of fatal/non-fatal CVD in Europe in individuals aged 40–69 without prior CVD or DM
score2_risk_tool.high_risk_threshold: ≥10% in low-risk countries; ≥7.5% in moderate-risk; ≥5% in high-risk; ≥2.5% in very-high-risk

pharmacotherapy.indication: Very high and high CV risk

pharmacotherapy.examples: evolocumab 140 mg Q2wk, alirocumab 75–150 mg Q2wk
pharmacotherapy.indication: Very high risk LDL ≥55 on max statin + ezetimibe

pharmacotherapy.examples: inclisiran 284 mg at 0, 3 months, then Q6months
pharmacotherapy.indication: ASCVD/FH unable to reach LDL targets
